displayName.text: PRIMO PIZZA 布利莫義式窯烤披薩 無接受訂位 週一公休

text.text:
We ordered 2 pizzas with 2 sides.
I think the owner attempts to create a traditional Italian style pizza , which is what I personally prefer. My misses always saids that id be most happy eating pizza 4 times a week 😅

However the pIzza was a bit too bland for our taste , pure tomato no salt no basil no oregano just plain crushed tomato.

I had a quatro formaggio which supposed to be a slightly bold pizza , but it had a odd sweetness to it , most likely wrong choice of cheese

Was it horrible? no
Was it great ? No

I'd rate the place a 6.1 out of 10
And hope they work on their sauce.
The dough was good I feel the oven was not hot enough to give some bite to the pizza

A very good thing was that they took some thought in the background music which was Italian.

text.text:
1.	Tables were left uncleared for over 40 minutes, causing waiting customers to wait far too long.
2.	If the dine-in orders can’t be handled in time, it’s recommended not to accept any more takeout or delivery orders.
3.	While all on-site customers were already seated and dining, staff were still calling customers to notify them it was their turn — are we in a parallel universe?
4.	Even when tables were available, customers were not called in promptly, resulting in a long line of people waiting at the entrance.
5.	If staff don’t have the capacity to take care of dine-in customers, it’s strongly recommended that the restaurant stop dine-in service and focus only on takeout orders.
6.	Staff appeared overwhelmed and disorganized; additional training is clearly needed.
7.	On-site floor management was chaotic and highly inefficient.
8.	If more staff are needed, then hire more — this is not the place to cut costs.
9.	If these issues are not addressed, simply apologizing repeatedly will only lead to a decline in the overall customer experience.
